definitions.explanation: The second planet from the sun, often visible as the brightest object in the morning or evening sky. Also called the morning star or evening star.

examples.japanese: {金星|きんせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧だ。
⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{金星|きんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Venus was visible in the evening sky.

examples.japanese: {金星|きんせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦{惑星|わくせい}→惑星：05052_wakusei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧だ。
examples.english: Venus is the closest planet to Earth, and it is nearly the same size.

notes:
USAGE: {金星|きんせい} refers to the planet Venus. It is also known as {明|あけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明星|みょうじょう} (morning star) and ⟦{宵|よい}の{明星|みょうじょう}→宵の明星：20968_yoinomyoujou⟧ (evening star).

Note: {金星|きんぼし} with the reading きんぼし is a different word meaning "upset victory" in sumo wrestling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金星|きんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧: observation of Venus
- {金星|きんせい}⟦{探査機|たんさき}→探査機：25715_tansaki⟧: Venus probe
- {金星|きんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧: the surface of Venus

ETYMOLOGY: Named {金星|きんせい} (gold star) based on the Chinese five-element system, where Venus corresponds to metal/gold ({金|きん}).
